C# — Stream2D

This feature is available only on camera models, capture modes, and firmware that provide Stream2D. The SDK returns the H264 data produced by the camera without decoding it.

Correspond EpicEye.Stream2D.cs and `EpicEye.Stream2D.Rtc.cs`Low. API Management SDP/peer; hosting sessions to create WebRTC Connect, frame and clean.

API Reference

Purpose: Query activity streams,peer . Number of numbers and camera graphics.

Parameters

Name Type Description

string

StopStream2DRtcSession / StopStream2DRtcSessionAsync

Purpose: Actively stop a hosting session while cleaning the cameraend peer and local RTC.

Parameters

Name Type Description

session

Stream2DRtcSession

WebRTC session.

Returns: None. SDK Just…​ RTP Reorganization H264 Encoding Frame Copy to Stream2DFrameData.Payload, do not decode or recode. If you want to display the image, hand the data over to the FFmpeg, hardware decoders or operations already have media pipelines.

fps Act only WebRtcOffer Ask for parameters to pass to the camera as they are.SDK Do not use it to limit, delay or discard the receiving frame. The soft trigger mode will output by the actual capacity of the camera, setting fps Do not change the output speed; the use of the value in the hard trigger mode is determined by the bottom of the camera.

Only one at each startup peer.StopStream2DRtcSession(session) Stops the session, without prejudice to the other receivers on the same camera.StopAllStream2D All incoming sessions on your device are used to stop, not for normal sessions to exit.

Only cameras with Stream2D enabled can create a session. Each session continues until it is stopped or the connection closes.

Example: Receive original H264 Frame

using TFTech;
using TFTech.Models;

await using var output = File.Create("stream.h264");
var targetReached = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

var response = await EpicEye.StartStream2DRtcSessionAsync(
    ip,
    onFrame: frame =>
    {
        output.Write(frame.Payload, 0, frame.Payload.Length);
        Console.WriteLine($"#{frame.FrameIndex} {frame.Codec} {frame.Payload.Length} bytes");
        if (frame.FrameIndex >= 100)
        {
            targetReached.TrySetResult();
        }
    },
    fps: 60,
    cameraIndex: 0);

if (response.Status != 0 || response.Data == null)
{
    throw new InvalidOperationException(response.ErrorMessage);
}

await using var session = response.Data;
await targetReached.Task;
await EpicEye.StopStream2DRtcSessionAsync(session);
Console.WriteLine($"Received {session.FrameCount} Frame");
